about: What a retained tree may hold, and nothing else (proof/matrix/layout.py reads it). A run's output and an artifact are data a container or another job wrote, so every member is named here: a directory name, a file name or pattern (matched whole), and a size bound. A new file the lane retains is named here in the same change that retains it.

media.extensions: each extension proof/matrix/stand-ins.json gives a stand-in

held.record: Under a block's output, retained-held/<tree>/<directory>/<test>.json for a directory the tree may hold, one record a comparing test, named by the test's node id quoted to one path segment or by its SHA-256 (proof/matrix/retained.py::record_name): a JSON object whose one key extra lists the paths under that directory its comparison found committed and did not make, each a file the tree's directory may hold.
held.name: [A-Za-z0-9_~%-][A-Za-z0-9_.~%-]{0,199}\.json
